
`rebuildEdges` stores an unresolvable target verbatim in `to_external` and `repointExternalEdges` fixes rows up when the target arrives, so forward references are accepted on write. `lode doc lint` (no argument) reports every unresolved edge and coverage-closure entry and every resolved edge whose anchor names no section of its target, exiting non-zero. `lode doc lint <file>` lints a draft's anchors before posting. Prose citations that name no document are also reported.
